datasets.name: agent-llm-traces
datasets.contributes: Agent execution traces, step timings, model invocations, and tool-use telemetry for general agent routing, latency/cost feature extraction, and intent classification.

datasets.name: AgentInstruct
datasets.contributes: High-quality agent instruction tuning trajectories, multi-step sub-task decomposition, and tool-use examples.

datasets.name: APIBench
datasets.contributes: APIs and tool documentation/call examples across HuggingFace, TorchHub, and TensorHub to teach tool selection, API parameter identification, and tool-use intent mapping.

datasets.name: awesome-harness-engineering
datasets.contributes: Agent harness design documents, patterns, schemas, and architectural guidelines that populate the FAISS retrieval corpus and workflow template clustering.

datasets.name: beir
datasets.contributes: Information retrieval and semantic search benchmark corpus used for building search/retrieval reference vectors and research intent labels.

datasets.name: Berkeley-Function-Calling-Leaderboard
datasets.contributes: Rigorous function calling benchmarks covering single, multiple, parallel, and AST function calls; maps queries to tool_use intents and coding/general agents.

datasets.name: code_generation_lite
datasets.contributes: Code generation tasks, test suites, and programming problems from LiveCodeBench lite; provides strong signals for code_generation intent and coding agent routing.

datasets.name: curated
datasets.contributes: Target-specific supervised datasets produced by prepare_supervised_datasets.py: approval (train.jsonl) for safety approvals, success (train.jsonl) for task completion, provider (train.jsonl) for multi-provider routing, and reward (train.jsonl) for preference scoring.

datasets.name: cx-cmu--agent_trajectories
datasets.contributes: End-to-end multi-turn agent interaction traces from SWE-bench, WebArena, and InterCode with ground truth binary reward signals; source for the curated 'success' predictor dataset.

datasets.name: EnvFactory-RL
datasets.contributes: Reinforcement learning environment interaction traces, rewards, and feedback logs for tool-agent policy learning and reward modeling.

datasets.name: EnvFactory-SFT-FILTERED
datasets.contributes: Supervised fine-tuning tool-use trajectories filtered for quality; directly supplies tool-agent supervision labels and step intent classifications.

datasets.name: HuggingFaceH4--ultrafeedback_binarized
datasets.contributes: Pairwise preference judgments containing prompt, chosen, and rejected responses; extracted by prepare_supervised_datasets.py to train reward scoring and ORPO alignment.

datasets.name: lmsyschatbot_arena_conversations
datasets.contributes: Real-world user prompts, dual-model conversations, and winner votes; mapped by capability affinity to OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google for ModelRouter training.

datasets.name: oasst1
datasets.contributes: Human-annotated conversation trees and quality ranks; contributes conversation and general intent supervision along with semantic text representations.

datasets.name: Open-M3-Bench
datasets.contributes: Multimodal Model Context Protocol (MCP) task workflows and environment states across diverse tooling environments; used to build workflow clusters and templates.

datasets.name: Qwen2.5-1.5B
datasets.contributes: Base model weights, configuration, and tokenizer files used as the initialization checkpoint for TRL ORPO reward fine-tuning in train_reward_orpo.py.

datasets.name: RouteLLM
datasets.contributes: LLM routing benchmarks, router evaluation datasets, and cost-quality trade-off thresholds.

datasets.name: routerbench
datasets.contributes: Martian RouterBench prompts with oracle_model_to_route_to labels; used by prepare_supervised_datasets.py to train ModelRouter.

datasets.name: scientific-agent-skills-main
datasets.contributes: Scientific agent skills, XML schemas, domain-specific bioinformatics formats, and CLI tool instructions; heavily contributes to FAISS retrieval, anomaly detection baselines, and research agent classification.

datasets.name: tau-bench-synthetic
datasets.contributes: Multi-turn synthetic conversational agent sessions across retail and airline domains; provides communication and tool action sequence signals.

datasets.name: wildguardmix
datasets.contributes: Safety evaluation corpus containing prompt_harm_label ('harmful' vs 'unharmful'); converted by prepare_supervised_datasets.py to train ApprovalPredictor.

datasets.name: xlam-function-calling-60k
datasets.contributes: 60,000 function-calling dialogues with exact tool schemas and API arguments; contributes to tool_use intent classification and coding/general agent routing.

datasets.name: xRouteBench
datasets.contributes: Multi-provider LLM candidate execution traces and queries across generic, memory, multimodal, time series, and video domains for model routing evaluation.

datasets.name: GAIA (Validation)
datasets.contributes: Validation benchmark for complex, multi-modal, tool-assisted agent reasoning to measure generalisation before test freeze.

datasets.name: curated (Testing)
datasets.contributes: Strictly held-out 20% test splits for approval (test.jsonl), success (test.jsonl), provider (test.jsonl), and reward (test.jsonl); evaluated by evaluate_models.py for F1, precision, recall, and calibration.

datasets.name: GAIA (Testing)
datasets.contributes: Held-out test benchmark evaluated by model/evaluate_holdout.py to assess agent and intent routing coverage on real multi-modal agent problems without label leakage.

datasets.name: SWE-bench_Verified (Testing)
datasets.contributes: Held-out real-world GitHub software engineering issues and patches; evaluated by model/evaluate_holdout.py for coding agent routing and task classification.
